description:
[read-only] Your ready voice clones in the brand (never a teammate's) and `defaultVoiceId`, the one generate_voice uses when `voiceId` is omitted. Free. `brandId` from list_brands, or `personal`; a brand-bound connection reads its own brand.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/generate/voice.)

brandId.description: Brand id (GET /api/v2/brands), or `personal`. Default: a bound key's brand, else your active brand. A bound key may only name its own brand.

name: list_voices
title: List speaking voices
